mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of at least 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are not significantly negative during periods when GDPC1 falls by 2% or more year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 8% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 8% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for six consecutive months signals broad-based supply-side weakness, which depresses earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are not significantly negative during periods of six consecutive months of INDPRO below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above their respective 12-month averages signals a high-inflation, high-rate environment, which erodes real corporate earnings and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceed their 12-month moving averages simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp month-over-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) of more than 10% from the previous month signals a collapse in residential investment, which negatively impacts construction and materials sectors and drags S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly negative when HOUST falls by more than 10% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A positive and accelerating growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200k per month for three consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, and thus positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200000 for 3 consecutive months AND 3-month delta of PAYEMS is increasing
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly positive during periods of three consecutive months with PAYEMS above 200k and accelerating growth.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated decline in both real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a broad-based demand shock, which reduces corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 MoM change < -1% AND HOUST MoM change < -1%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are not significantly negative when both GDPC1 and HOUST fall by more than 1% month-over-month.
